pitch_routes.genre: Investigative / current affairs (FRONTLINE), science (NOVA), lifestyle (GBH Studio Six)
pitch_routes.route: GBH Content Submission Form (review GBH editorial guidelines and sign GBH Content Submission Release Form first). Rolling review; GBH says it will respond within 6-8 weeks if it wants to proceed. FRONTLINE prefers one-hour single-subject films and does not accept advocacy-funded projects; NOVA mainly wants 52-min docs but considers features and multipart series; sizzles/short proposals accepted.

FRONTLINE FAQ: well-researched proposals, completed films and works-in-progress via the GBH submissions portal; tips and story suggestions to frontline@pbs.org (about 500 suggestions/proposals a year).

POV Call for Entries on FilmFreeway: completed films and fine cuts, shorts of 40 min or less, invited feature rough cuts. Deadline for the 2027 broadcast season was 31 Jul 2026; rolling submissions after that roll into the following year's cycle. Questions: cfe@pov.org.

ITVS Get Funded page: Open Call (single nonfiction projects over 10 min already in production/post), Incubator Fund (early-stage features/web series for public media streaming) and Independent Lens Creator Lab (vertical micro-series) are all marked 'Not currently accepting applications' as of 8 Nov 2026. Series and Special Projects funding is invitation-only.

briefs.title: PBS chief programming executive Sylvia Bugg has died; no successor named
briefs.summary: PBS CEO Paula Kerger announced the death of Sylvia Bugg, Chief Programming Executive and General Manager for General Audience Programming. Neither the PBS statement nor coverage names an interim or permanent successor - the central PBS programming commissioner seat is unverified as of 8 Nov 2026.

briefs.title: American Experience reimagined: multi-episode deep dives, digital-first formats
briefs.summary: GBH/PBS reshaping American Experience around multi-episode limited series (first: Lindbergh, 2027), YouTube/TikTok and short-form; NOVA five-part Evolution for fall 2026.

briefs.title: American Experience announces new slate of limited series
briefs.summary: Lindbergh (3 parts, May 2027), The Bureau: A Secret History of the FBI (4 parts, fall 2027), untitled Great Depression series in development. Raney Aronson-Rath leads the new GBH documentary unit (American Experience, NOVA, FRONTLINE).

briefs.title: ITVS leadership transition: Lois Vossen interim CEO
briefs.summary: Carrie Lozano stepped down as ITVS President and CEO; Lois Vossen (founding EP of Independent Lens) is Interim President and CEO while the board runs a national search.

briefs.title: POV season 39 slate
briefs.summary: POV's 39th season launched 20 Jul 2026 with The Dating Game; slate includes For Venida, For Kalief, The Gas Station Attendant, How to Build a Library, Arrest the Midwife, Remake.

briefs.title: ITVS Creator Lab and Incubator Fund
briefs.summary: Independent Lens Creator Lab (six vertical-video creators, up to $36k each) announced; Incubator Fund for early-stage nonfiction opened 2 Jan 2026. Both now closed.
